# LANXTOR E1

> E1 by Lanxtor Inc. is plant engineering software for production and power plants: FEED, process, P&IDs, instrumentation, electrical, automation and maintenance on one data model (a single source of truth), cloud native and AI native, with Alex, the AI co-engineer.

Lanxtor Inc., 7545 Irvine Center Drive, Suite 200, Irvine, California 92618, USA. Email info@lanxtor.com, sales sales@lanxtor.com, support support@lanxtor.com, phone +1 (949) 400 1129. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lanxtor/

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.lanxtor.com/index.html): what E1 is, how every discipline works on one data model, and Alex.
- [Solutions](https://www.lanxtor.com/solutions.html): every feature of E1, by discipline.
- [Get E1](https://www.lanxtor.com/download.html): the desktop app for macOS and Windows, E1 Cloud or an enterprise installation, licenses and prices, the 30-day trial.
- [E1 Cloud specifications](https://www.lanxtor.com/cloud-specifications.html): where E1 Cloud data is kept (Microsoft Azure North Europe, Ireland), measured performance, security, who can see what, backups and recovery, standards, apps and limits.
- [Academy](https://www.lanxtor.com/academy.html): the E1 Academy training and certificates; USD 750 per person, included with the annual E1 Editor subscription.
- [Contact sales](https://www.lanxtor.com/contact-sales.html): licensing, trials, demos and enterprise deployment.
- [Contact us](https://www.lanxtor.com/shape-e1.html): sales, support, feature requests and joining the team.
- [About us](https://www.lanxtor.com/about.html): the company, the founder and the team.
